name: versovox
description: Self-hosted tandem reading: a non-destructive reader/player overlay for existing ebook and audiobook libraries.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @versovox/shared && npm run build --workspace @versovox/server && npm run build --workspace @versovox/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @versovox/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
